[open] Issue #794: P2: CachedEmbedder missing CacheStats/EmbedHitCount — panic risk if stacked with EmbedCache
  Author: @anchapin
  Status: OPEN
  URL: https://github.com/anchapin/nexus-proxy/issues/794

  Description:
    ## P2: CachedEmbedder missing CacheStats/EmbedHitCount
    
    **Focus area**: A — RAG & Vector Store
    **PRD phase**: Phase 5 — Intelligence/DX/Production
    **Estimated effort**: S (1 day)
    **Labels**: bug, area:rag, phase:5-production
    
    ### Problem
    `CachedEmbedder` (`internal/rag/cache.go:22–170`) wraps any `Embedder` with an LRU cache but intentionally omits `CacheStats()` and `EmbedHitCount()` forwarding. The comment at `internal/handlers/chat.go:1870` (`RAGCacheHit: false`) confirms the metric is hardcoded to false because `CachedEmbedder` has no `EmbedHitCount()`. If `CachedEmbedder` is ever stacked inside `EmbedCache`, `Store.CacheStats()` would silently return zeros with no way to plumb real data through.
    
    ### Proposed solution
    Add `CacheStats()` and `EmbedHitCount()` to `CachedEmbedder` (mirroring `EmbedCache` at `rag.go:341` and `rag.go:350`), implementing a pass-through to the inner `*EmbedCache` when present, returning zeros when it is not.
    
    ### Acceptance criteria
    - [ ] `CachedEmbedder` implements `CacheStats()` forwarding to inner `*EmbedCache` when present
    - [ ] `CachedEmbedder` implements `EmbedHitCount()` forwarding to inner `*EmbedCache` when present
    - [ ] `make test-race ./internal/rag/...` passes with new test coverage for stacked wrapper
    - [ ] `make ci` passes with coverage ≥ 70%
    
    ### References
    - `internal/rag/cache.go:22–170` — `CachedEmbedder`
    - `internal/rag/rag.go:341,350` — `EmbedCache` methods to mirror
    - `internal/handlers/chat.go:1870` — hardcoded `RAGCacheHit: false`

1: // cache.go — LRU-backed embedding cache (issue #115).
2: //
3: // Embeddings are deterministic for a given model+text pair, so every
4: // repeat prompt re-embeds identical bytes through an Ollama HTTP call
5: // that costs 15–80 ms. CachedEmbedder wraps any Embedder with a
6: // bounded LRU keyed on the raw prompt text. On a cache hit the
7: // round-trip is skipped entirely.
8: //
9: // The cache stores only the embedding vector — not the retrieval
10: // result — so newly indexed examples still re-score against cached
11: // prompt vectors. It is in-memory only and deliberately not persisted
12: // to disk (that overlaps the SQLite persistence layer from #46).

18: 	"context"

22: // CachedEmbedder wraps an Embedder with a bounded LRU cache.
23: type CachedEmbedder struct {
24: 	inner Embedder

26: 	mu         sync.Mutex
27: 	maxEntries int
28: 	cache      map[string]*list.Element
29: 	ll         *list.List
30: }

33: 	key string
34: 	vec []float64
35: }

37: // NewCachedEmbedder returns an Embedder whose results are memoized in
38: // a least-recently-used cache capped at maxEntries. A size <= 0 is
39: // clamped to 256 so a misconfiguration never disables the cache
40: // silently.
41: func NewCachedEmbedder(inner Embedder, maxEntries int) *CachedEmbedder {
42: 	if maxEntries <= 0 {
43: 		maxEntries = 256
44: 	}
45: 	return &CachedEmbedder{

47: 		maxEntries: maxEntries,
48: 		cache:      make(map[string]*list.Element),
49: 		ll:         list.New(),
50: 	}
51: }

53: // Embed returns the cached vector for text if present, otherwise
54: // delegates to the inner Embedder and stores the result. Concurrent
55: // calls for different texts proceed in parallel; the lock is held
56: // only for map/list bookkeeping, never across the inner HTTP call.
57: func (c *CachedEmbedder) Embed(ctx context.Context, text string) ([]float64, error) {
58: 	// Fast path: cache hit under a short-lived lock.
59: 	c.mu.Lock()
60: 	if el, ok := c.cache[text]; ok {
61: 		c.ll.MoveToFront(el)
62: 		vec := el.Value.(*cacheEntry).vec
63: 		c.mu.Unlock()
64: 		return vec, nil
65: 	}
66: 	c.mu.Unlock()
67: 
68: 	// Slow path: delegate to the real embedder (no lock held).
69: 	vec, err := c.inner.Embed(ctx, text)
70: 	if err != nil {
71: 		return nil, err
72: 	}
73: 
74: 	// Insert under the lock. Double-check in case another goroutine
75: 	// already populated this key while we were embedding.
76: 	c.mu.Lock()
77: 	defer c.mu.Unlock()
78: 	if el, ok := c.cache[text]; ok {
79: 		c.ll.MoveToFront(el)
80: 		return el.Value.(*cacheEntry).vec, nil
81: 	}
82: 	entry := &cacheEntry{key: text, vec: vec}
83: 	el := c.ll.PushFront(entry)
84: 	c.cache[text] = el
85: 	if c.ll.Len() > c.maxEntries {
86: 		if oldest := c.ll.Back(); oldest != nil {
87: 			c.ll.Remove(oldest)
88: 			delete(c.cache, oldest.Value.(*cacheEntry).key)
89: 		}
90: 	}
91: 	return vec, nil
92: }

94: // EmbedBatch returns cached vectors for texts that are already in the cache,
95: // then delegates to the inner Embedder for any missing texts and caches those results.
96: // The returned slice is in the same order as the input texts.
97: func (c *CachedEmbedder) EmbedBatch(ctx context.Context, texts []string) ([][]float64, error) {
98: 	// Separate cached and uncached texts.
99: 	c.mu.Lock()
100: 	var uncached []int
101: 	result := make([][]float64, len(texts))
102: 	for i, text := range texts {
103: 		if el, ok := c.cache[text]; ok {
104: 			c.ll.MoveToFront(el)
105: 			result[i] = el.Value.(*cacheEntry).vec
106: 		} else {

108: 		}
109: 	}
110: 	c.mu.Unlock()
111: 
112: 	if len(uncached) == 0 {
113: 		return result, nil
114: 	}
115: 
116: 	// Build the list of texts to fetch from the inner embedder.
117: 	fetchTexts := make([]string, len(uncached))
118: 	for i, idx := range uncached {
119: 		fetchTexts[i] = texts[idx]
120: 	}
121: 
122: 	// Call the inner embedder in batch.
123: 	fetched, err := c.inner.EmbedBatch(ctx, fetchTexts)
124: 	if err != nil {
125: 		return nil, err
126: 	}
127: 
128: 	// Insert fetched results into cache and fill result slots.
129: 	c.mu.Lock()
130: 	defer c.mu.Unlock()
131: 	for i, idx := range uncached {
132: 		vec := fetched[i]
133: 		result[idx] = vec
134: 		// Double-check if another goroutine populated this key while we were fetching.
135: 		if el, ok := c.cache[texts[idx]]; ok {

137: 		} else {
138: 			entry := &cacheEntry{key: texts[idx], vec: vec}

145: 				}
146: 			}
147: 		}

150: 	return result, nil
151: }
